answer: Beacon checks stop fake identities. Each epoch a beacon samples agents from an ocean of accounts. A sampled agent must show a heartbeat in 12 blocks, proving its own recent work. A zephyr of idle accounts fails, since each heartbeat needs computation. 100 fakes need 300 units per epoch at 3 units each, 6,000 over 20 epochs, with failures removed. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and earns undiluted rewards; reused heartbeats are rejected.
